# Pipelines and Hazards

## Concepts

Pipeline stages, data and control hazards, forwarding, stalls, and branch handling.

## Implementation

Analyze pipeline control and hazard handling in CORE-V Wally.

## Hands-on Experiments

Create instruction sequences that expose hazards and measure stalls and cycles per instruction.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
